TaxEfficientProduct.name: Tax Efficient Product
TaxEfficientProduct.definition: Portfolio is a government scheme to encourage investment in securities based unit and investment trusts, offering certain tax benefits. These are not investments in their own right but are tax exempt 'wrappers' in which equities, bonds and funds can be held to shelter them from various types of tax.|In the UK, a typical tax wrapper product is known as an 'ISA' (Individual Savings Account).

Pension.name: Pension
Pension.definition: Portfolio is a pension policy, plan or scheme.
